description: System must have a formally approved User Requirements Specification (URS) defining all GxP business and technical requirements.
Document must clearly declare a formal version identifier (e.g., v1.0, v2.1) in compliance with ALCOA+ traceability.
Document must include explicit QA, System Owner, and Business Owner approval signatures or electronic approval records.
Document periodic review date must be within valid cycle (e.g. within the last 24 months, not overdue).

requirement: Audit trail and electronic signature controls defined
description: System specifications must explicitly define 21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11 compliant audit trail and electronic signature controls.

requirement: GxP impact and data integrity risk assessment completed
description: Formal risk assessment must categorize GxP criticality, data integrity risk (ALCOA+), and patient safety controls.

requirement: Change control and release management traceability documented
description: Traceability must link functional requirements to validated change control procedures and test verifications.

requirement: Role-based access control (RBAC) and segregation of duties defined
description: System must document user role definitions, segregation of duties, and periodic access review requirements.
